Vote on draft reports on the extended producer responsibility
On 5 October 2026, ENVI Members voted on two draft reports concerning the temporary suspension of authorised representative requirements under several extended producer responsibility (EPR) schemes. The two Commission proposals, presented as part of the Environmental Omnibus package on 10 December 2025, aimed to reduce administrative burdens.
They would suspend until 1 January 2035 the requirement to appoint authorised representatives under legislation on batteries, packaging, waste electrical and electronic equipment, and single-use plastics. In her draft reports, the rapporteur proposed limiting the suspension to micro and small enterprises, reflecting their more limited administrative and financial capacity. She also clarified that the measure should remain temporary pending the future review of EPR obligations under the forthcoming Circular Economy Act. In addition, the rapporteur proposed maintaining existing requirements for producers established in third countries, citing ongoing challenges related to traceability and enforcement outside the Union.
